Card: #34601 item 2 · claim 6940933031 (continuing 6937484878 under amendment 6939423758) · os-dev-report 6940890993 · item 1 landed as PR #34658

Item 2 is traced to the real producer, measured live, and fixed in the smallest place that covers it. The seat's Q1 = A ruling (an explicit width stays exact) holds. The claim's corrected premise and amended surface name all four files. No must-fix and no should-fix.

### Must-fix

None.

### Should-fix

None.

### Readings that hold

| Item | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR shape | Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34601`, with no other closing verb. Item 1 (#34658, `Part of`) is already merged, so closing the card here leaves nothing open. No `!` and no `(narrowing)`, so no dogfood battery is owed. |
| Scope | 4 files: `data-table.tsx` (+22/−3), the new `data-table-lookup-picker-floor-34601.test.tsx`, `types/src/data-display.ts` (+6, jsdoc only) and the changeset. Claim 6940933031 names `complex/data-table.tsx`, `complex/__tests__/**`, `types/src/data-display.ts (doc comment only)` and `.changeset/`. All in surface. |
| Premise correction | The card points at `GridField`, but the live reading shows `GridField` draws an unpinned lookup at 168px. The narrow column comes from `data-table` auto-width on an Edit-inline list ("Consulting Hour" → 121px, trigger 51px at 820). The claim records this as `Premise: corrected`, and the PR's Live measurement table gives before and after at 1280/1024/820, plus the inline-off control (still 121px). |
| Code | `pickerEdits = editable && col.foreignKey === true && col.editable !== false`. `pickerFloor` applies `Math.max(width, 168)` on both auto paths: the drawn-px path and the char estimate. Explicit-width columns `continue` before either path, and `fitContent` keeps its own branch, so a view pin or a persisted user resize is drawn as written (Q1 = A). `editable` is added to the `useMemo` deps, so toggling inline edit re-sizes. The cap stays 400 > 168, so the floor never fights it. `GridField` is untouched. |
| Clause-② / Metadata-protocol | `no` / `none` in the claim, PR body and changeset. Read against the diff: no export is added (`LOOKUP_PICKER_MIN_WIDTH` is module-private), and no key is added to `TableColumn`. The `data-display.ts` hunk is jsdoc on the existing `foreignKey` member, so `@object-ui/types`' type surface is byte-identical apart from a comment. |
| Changeset | `patch` on `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/types`, the two published packages whose `src` moved. The sentences match the code: "In an editable table, a foreign-key column … whose cells edit is now never narrower than 168px" = `pickerEdits`. "A wider name still widens the column" = `Math.max`. "A width the view pins, or the user's own resize, is drawn exactly as written" = the `col.width` skip. "read-only tables and columns that do not edit are unchanged" = the `editable` and `col.editable !== false` terms. |
| Tests | The new file has 3 tests. 168px vs 112px. Controls: a read-only table, no `foreignKey`, and `editable: false` all stay 112px. A wide name (320px) and an explicit `width: 90` are kept. The ablation (floor → `(width)`) turns the first test red, 1/3, and is restored to blob `f19704007c07` with `git diff HEAD` empty. Real commands with output: 38 files / 248 tests under the lock. Type-check for components and types exits 0. 38/38 derived gates. |
| UI strings | None added. |
| Docs | Searched `content/docs`, `skills` and the components README for the table's auto-width floor and for `foreignKey`. Nothing describes them, so nothing is made false. The `TableColumn.foreignKey` jsdoc is updated in this PR. |
| Acceptance | 1 (read each product's full name in the picker) comes from both items together. #34658's 18rem popover floor is on `main`, and this PR gives the trigger room (98px at 820). With #34658 applied, the PR reads the popover at 288px. 2 (the popover stays inside the viewport on a narrow screen) is #34658's `max-w-(--radix-popover-content-available-width)`, and the right edge reads 820 at an 820 viewport. |
| Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34693`: NOT governed, 124 lines. Tier S, lands through o3-C. |
| CI on this head | 62 check-runs: 46 `success`, 15 `skipped`, 1 `failure`. The failure is the first PR-body-guards job (133869992882, 06:43Z), which ran before claim 6940933031 (06:46Z) named this branch. The re-run on the same head (133871916846, 06:47Z) is `success`. Test UI 16/16 shards plus the aggregate, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Check Changeset, Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are all `success`. |

### Notes

1. **A masked foreign-key column is floored too.** `pickerEdits` does not exclude `col.masked`, but the cell-edit gate does (`isEditable = editable && col.editable !== false && !col.masked && …`). So a masked lookup column in an editable table is drawn at 168px though it never opens the picker. This is harmless and rare. Adding `&& col.masked !== true` would make the two readings match.
2. **Grouped editable lists are not covered.** `groupedColumnWidths` in `ObjectGrid.tsx` sets explicit widths with its own 80px floor, so a grouped Edit-inline list keeps a narrow lookup column. Declared in the PR. That file is in #34615's in-flight surface, and the os-dev report carries it to the seat. A follow-up card would keep it from being lost.
3. **168 is spelled twice**, here and in `GridField`'s `MIN_WIDTH_BY_TYPE.lookup`. The `data-table.tsx` constant's comment points at `GridField`, and `GridField` is not touched. That is the right call while `components` cannot import `fields` and a new export would make this Clause-② yes.
